note: Re-judged 2026-11-02 (independent auditor, after efa0d0957e). RFC 9494 Section 4.3: "The route SHOULD NOT be advertised to any neighbor from which the Long-Lived Graceful Restart Capability has not been received. The exception is described in Section 4.6." Section 4.6 allows stale routes to internal neighbors only with NO_EXPORT attached and LOCAL_PREF set to zero. efa0d0957e changed only the header comment of test/plugin/llgr-egress-state-unloaded.ci (bgp-gr may now run forked; the state lives beside the evaluator); every action, expectation and the config are byte-identical, so obsn (iBGP RR client, no LLGR Capability in its OPEN) must still first receive 10.0.0.0/24 and then an UPDATE carrying NO_EXPORT (FFFFFF01), which the source never sends. The producer moved rails, not decisions: gr_filter.go grInsertions places bgp-gr:llgr-egress on every peer's export list (FilterScopeAnyPeer, Required, Readvertise true) while any peer sets long-lived-stale-time, and evaluateLLGREgress calls LLGREgressFilter (gr_egress.go), whose hasLLGR-false, PeerAS==LocalAS branch adds NO_EXPORT and sets LOCAL_PREF 0; llgrEgressVerdict maps those mods to community add 65535:65281 and local-preference set 0, and an eBGP non-LLGR destination to FilterWithdraw. So the NO_EXPORT the .ci awaits can only come from this member answering the Section 4.6 exception, and an accept-unchanged break would never deliver it. The aliased-plugin Stage 1 red (9501e4a6f5) that hit this config shape is fixed by e05a3969a7. The Go units under the row (egress rails, nil-state eBGP withdraw, LLGR-peer pass-through, RIB replay level, cached and route-server forward withholding, relay rebuilt mark) are unchanged and still pair both polarities: withdraw toward eBGP non-LLGR, depreference toward iBGP non-LLGR, unchanged toward an LLGR peer, level 1 passes through. Comment nit, not a finding: the header cites llgr-readvertise-forked.ci for the forked state; llgr-readvertise-multipeer-forked.ci is the forked twin that carries the non-LLGR destination. No discrimination record exists for the .ci and this auditor did not run it; its green rests on efa0d0957e's worktree evidence. Verdict stands.
